data.name: Faqiih
data.gender_notes: Faqiih is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who has acquired extensive knowledge and expertise in Islamic law and jurisprudence. A title of respect for a learned and knowledgeable individual in the Islamic community. The name Faqiih carries the meaning “Expert, Scholar, Jurist” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Faqiih usually hope their child will grow to embody expert, scholar, jurist and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: To seek knowledge and wisdom from the Quran and Hadith, and to apply it in daily life to become a righteous and just leader.
data.etymology: Faqiih belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Expert, Scholar, Jurist.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Faqiih total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: فقيه
in_arabic.meaning: فقيه تعني الشخص الذي يفهم الدين والقانون الإسلامي
in_arabic.long_meaning: فقيه هو الشخص الذي يمتلك فهمًا عميقًا للدين الإسلامي والقوانين المتعلقة به، وهو ما يعرف بالفقه الإسلامي. يأتي هذا الاسم من الجذر العربي 'ف-ق-هـ' الذي يعني الفهم والادراك. ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم في سورة البقرة الآية 282 'وليستعرف بعضكم بعضا'. يعتبر الفقيه شخصًا ذا علم ودراية واسعة في أمور الدين والفقه، مما يجعله مؤهلًا لإفتاء الناس وتقديم الفتاوى والاستشارات الدينية.

in_urdu.name: فقیہ
in_urdu.meaning: فقیہ کا مطلب ہے جو اسلامک قانون اور دین کو سمجھتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: فقیہ وہ شخص ہے جو اسلامی قانون اور دین کے اصولوں کو گہرائی سے سمجھتا ہے۔ یہ نام عربی جڑ 'ف-ق-هـ' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے سمجھنا اور ادراک کرنا۔ فقہ اسلامی علم کا ایک اہم حصہ ہے جو اسلامی قانون اور ضوابط کے ساتھ منسلک ہے۔ فقہی علم کی اہمیت اسلامی تاریخ میں گہری جڑیں رکھتی ہے، جہاں فقہاء (فقیہ کی جمع) دین کے معاملات میں لوگوں کی رہنمائی کرتے تھے۔

in_hindi.name: फ़क़ीह
in_hindi.meaning: फ़क़ीह का अर्थ है जो इस्लामी कानून और धर्म को समझता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: फ़क़ीह वह व्यक्ति है जो इस्लामी कानून और धर्म के सिद्धांतों को गहराई से समझता है। यह नाम अरबी मूल 'फ-ق-हـ' से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है समझना और बोध करना। फ़क़ीह की भूमिका इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है, जहां वह लोगो को धर्म और कानून के मामलों में मार्गदर्शन प्रदान करता है। इस्लामी इतिहास में फ़क़ीहों का बहुत महत्व रहा है, जिन्होंने विभिन्न समयों पर इस्लामी विधि और धर्म के प्रसार में महत्वपूर्ण योगदान दिया है।

in_pashto.name: فقيه
in_pashto.meaning: فقيه د معنی دا چې چا د اسلامي قانون او دين پوهیږي
in_pashto.long_meaning: فقيه هغه څوک دی چې د اسلامي قانون او دين اصول ژوره پوهيږي. دا نوم د عربي ريښې 'ف-ق-هـ' څخه اخيستل شوی دی چې د پوهنې او ادراک معنی لري. په افغانستان او پښتونستان کې، فقيه د يو دينی عالم په توګه پېر او اعتبار لري چې د خلکو د دينی او قانوني پوښتنو ځوابونه ورکوي.

in_english.name: Faqiih
in_english.meaning: Faqiih means one who understands Islamic law and religion deeply
in_english.long_meaning: Faqiih refers to a person who possesses a profound understanding of Islamic law (fiqh) and religion. The term originates from the Arabic root 'ف-ق-هـ' (f-q-h), which signifies understanding or comprehension. In Islamic tradition, a faqiih is a scholar well-versed in fiqh, capable of providing guidance on religious and legal matters. The role of a faqiih has been historically significant, with such scholars playing crucial roles in interpreting Islamic law and advising the community throughout Islamic history.

data.cultural_impact: The title "Faqih" holds great significance in the cultural context of the Islamic community. Being a scholar of Islamic law and jurisprudence bestows upon the individual a high status and respect within the society. They are considered authorities in Islamic education, advisors on religious matters, and teachers of young scholars. The title is a testament to the individual's dedication, hard work, and extensive knowledge of Islamic teachings and principles.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, being a Faqih represents a deep connection to and mastery of the divine laws of God as revealed through the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). The pursuit of this knowledge is a lifelong commitment that requires unwavering faith, dedication, and discipline. The Faqih serves as a bridge between the divine law and the people, guiding them in their religious and spiritual practices. Through their knowledge and wisdom, they help strengthen the community's connection to God and inspire others to seek knowledge and grow in their faith.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Expert, Scholar, Jurist" symbolizes One who has acquired extensive knowledge and expertise in Islamic law and jurisprudence. A title of respect for a learned and knowledgeable individual in the Islamic community.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Faqiih serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of expert, scholar, jurist.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Abi Dunya and Ibn Jarir al-Tabari The name Faqiih carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Both scholars were renowned jurists and theologians, often referred to as Faqihs. Ibn Abi Dunya was a student of Abu Hanifa, the founder of the Hanafi school of thought. He was known for his extensive knowledge in fiqh (Islamic jurisprudence). Ibn Jarir al-Tabari, on the other hand, was a prolific historian and commentator on the Quran who also made significant contributions to jurisprudence. He was a leading scholar in the Shafi'i school of thought.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Al-Shafi'i and Ibn Hanbal The name Faqiih carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Al-Shafi'i is considered the founder of the Shafi'i school of Islamic law. He was a prominent jurist and scholar, and his works had a profound impact on the development of fiqh. Ibn Hanbal, on the other hand, was a strong proponent of the Hanbali school of thought and a leading figure in the Sunni movement against the Mutazilites. Both scholars were referred to as Faqihs due to their extensive knowledge in Islamic jurisprudence.

modern_usage.modern_context: In modern times, the title 'Faqih' is a revered designation for a Muslim scholar who possesses an extensive knowledge of Islamic law, theology, and Quranic studies. Faqihs are often considered as religious leaders and advisors in their communities. They play a significant role in interpreting Islamic law and providing legal advice, especially in matters concerning family, business, and personal affairs. Faqihs are active on various platforms, including social media, academic institutions, and mosques and religious centers. Through these channels, they engage in interactive debates, offer guidance, and provide counseling services. The trend towards digital media has made it possible for Faqihs to reach a wider audience, expand their influence, and contribute to the global Islamic discourse.
